name: mirage
text:
Tennis is tightened and live on main. The engine picks it up the next time it restarts (it hands over about every 6 hours). I can also restart it now if you want.
- Tennis bets (ATP and WTA): the engine only takes one when at least 6 books say it's +EV on their own, every book that prices both sides agrees, and the edge is at least 5%.
- Tennis bids: they now need 6 books agreeing; before, a single book was enough.
- I didn't add a favorites-only rule. ATP favorite spreads lost most, but the sample is too small to cut on.
- Everything is logged in CHANGES.md with how to revert. Tests pass (2,969).

Novig key: the engine that started at 04:08 UTC says no Novig read-only key is present on GitHub. The secret isn't there, so your send at about 04:06 didn't reach it. Please send it again from Settings › Cloud scan › Send a Novig read-only key. Read the result line under the button. If it shows an error, tell me what it says.
